entities.summary: Yitzhak Tshuva is an Israeli billionaire businessman. He is the founder of El-Ad Group, a real estate development and holding company, which owned the New York Plaza Hotel. He also owns the Israeli conglomerate Delek Group. As of March 2026, Forbes estimated his net worth at US$8.3 billion.
